name: Dragonborn of Bahamut
printedArtCredit: Emily Fiegenschuh, Rite of Rebirth scene, p. 8. Eric Polak, former forms group, p. 9.
sourceDistinctions: The rite retains original type, racial Hit Dice, base movement, size, racial adjustments and level adjustment. It removes most other original racial traits.
Heart, Mind, and Wings are mutually exclusive. Wings can glide at first level and gains powered flight at 6 HD.
The 2006 player species is scoped separately from the same-name Fizban monster and other Dragonborn species printings.
The published dwarf-origin Fighter retains racial bonuses that the Rite of Rebirth removes. The staged dwarf-origin Fighter follows p. 10.
portraitForm: Orra Slatefall, an original Wings-aspect Dragonborn Fighter
